import re
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

BASE = "C:/Users/<user>/AppData/Local/Temp/prompt-evals-session-1idov1y1"
lines = open(f"{BASE}/personal_expenses.txt", encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()

MONTHS = {"jun": 6, "june": 6, "jul": 7, "july": 7, "aug": 8, "august": 8}
DATE_PATTERNS = [
    (r"\b(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b", "iso"),
    (r"\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})/(\d{2}|\d{4})\b", "slash_y"),
    (r"\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})\b", "slash"),
    (r"\b(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b", "mmdd"),
    (r"\b(Jun|June|Jul|July|Aug|August)\.?\s+(\d{1,2})\b", "named"),
]
AMOUNT = re.compile(r"(-?)\$?(\d+\.\d{2})(?!\d)")

RULES = [
    ("Subscriptions", [r"icloud", r"amazon prime", r"netflix", r"spotify premium", r"planet fitness app"]),
    ("Uncategorized", [r"zelle", r"paypal transfer", r"atm cash"]),
    ("Peer payments", [r"venmo"]),
    ("Entertainment", [r"spotify concert", r"ticketmaster", r"amc theatres", r"bowl-o-rama", r"\bsteam\b"]),
    ("Eating out & coffee", [r"local coffee", r"starbucks", r"chipotle", r"mcdonald", r"panera", r"sushi kame",
                             r"thai orchid", r"rustic tap", r"bagel corner", r"luigi"]),
    ("Groceries", [r"trader joe", r"\baldi\b", r"kroger", r"whole foods", r"costco"]),
    ("Gas & car", [r"\bshell\b", r"chevron", r"bp gas", r"jiffy lube"]),
    ("Rideshare & parking", [r"\blyft\b", r"\buber\b", r"city parking"]),
    ("Travel", [r"delta air", r"marriott", r"\bhertz\b", r"airport parking"]),
    ("Phone & internet", [r"xfinity", r"verizon"]),
    ("Health", [r"riverside physical", r"hensley", r"walgreens", r"\bcvs\b", r"planet fitness"]),
    ("Home", [r"home depot", r"\bikea\b"]),
    ("Shopping", [r"amazon", r"\btarget\b", r"best buy", r"old navy", r"\brei\b", r"barnes & noble"]),
]


def categorize(text):
    t = text.lower()
    for cat, pats in RULES:
        if any(re.search(p, t) for p in pats):
            return cat
    return "UNMATCHED"


def parse_date(text):
    for pat, kind in DATE_PATTERNS:
        m = re.search(pat, text, re.I)
        if not m:
            continue
        if kind == "iso":
            y, mo, d = int(m[1]), int(m[2]), int(m[3])
        elif kind == "slash_y":
            mo, d, y = int(m[1]), int(m[2]), int(m[3])
            y = y + 2000 if y < 100 else y
        elif kind in ("slash", "mmdd"):
            mo, d, y = int(m[1]), int(m[2]), 2026
        else:
            mo, d, y = MONTHS[m[1].lower()], int(m[2]), 2026
        return date(y, mo, d), m.group(0)
    return None, None


def parse_amount(text):
    found = AMOUNT.findall(text)
    if not found:
        return None
    sign, num = found[-1]
    v = Decimal(num)
    return -v if sign else v


rows, problems = [], []
for n, raw in enumerate(lines, 1):
    if n <= 2 or not raw.strip():
        continue
    text = re.sub(r"^\s*-\s+", "", raw)
    d, dtok = parse_date(text)
    amt = parse_amount(text)
    if d is None or amt is None:
        problems.append((n, raw))
        continue
    desc = text.replace(dtok, " ", 1)
    desc = AMOUNT.sub(" ", desc)
    desc = re.sub(r"[\$\(\)\|,:\-–—]+", " ", desc)
    desc = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", desc).strip()
    rows.append(dict(line=n, date=d, merchant=desc, amount=amt, category=categorize(text), raw=raw))

print(f"Transaction lines parsed: {len(rows)}   unparseable: {len(problems)}")
for p in problems:
    print("  UNPARSEABLE", p)
unmatched = [r for r in rows if r["category"] == "UNMATCHED"]
